headline: Six identity.* modeling-rule PRs land in one day; Orca's event collector fixes pagination
summary_md:
- The `identity.*` modeling-rule series lands in bulk: PRs 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 of 7 all merge on the same day (#45448, #45565, #45438, #45436, #45437, #45462).
- Yesterday's revert is undone — **GuardiCore** (+962), **Silverfort** (+177), **CommvaultBackupSolutions** (+121) and **CitrixADC** (+117) regain almost exactly the lines PR 2's revert removed.
- 36 packs move and 19 of them are addition-only against a single deleted line; **Azure** (+1,383) and **Orca** (+1,160/-242) are the largest.
- Two collection fixes land: XDR Collector RFC-3164 syslog now ingests into `linux_linux_raw` (#45574), and Arista Switch parsing accepts millisecond timestamps (#45571).

highlights.title: The reverted identity.* modeling rules return, with a CitrixADC fix attached
highlights.detail: PR 2 of 7 re-lands as #45565 carrying a fix for malformed coalesce nesting in CitrixADC_2_11, and the four packs cut back yesterday recover within a line or two of what they lost.

highlights.title: Six of the seven identity.* modeling-rule PRs merge on one day
highlights.detail: PRs 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 land under CRTX-271523, CRTX-271525 and CRTX-271526; only PR 3 is absent from the day's commits.

highlights.title: Orca Event Collector fixes event pagination and cursor handling
highlights.detail: At +1,160/-242 it is the day's only substantial rewrite, and it adds an _ENTRY_STATUS field (#45415).

highlights.title: XDR Collector RFC-3164 syslog is ingested into linux_linux_raw
highlights.detail: LinuxEventsCollection gains 253 lines against 3 deleted for the new syslog path (#45574).

highlights.title: AWS S3 command context outputs are rewritten
highlights.detail: The AWS pack moves +157/-67 updating the context outputs of its S3 commands (#45254) — the largest deletion count of the day outside Orca.

highlights.title: Arista Switch parsing rule accepts millisecond timestamps
highlights.detail: A seven-line change adds millisecond timestamp format support to the parsing rule (#45571).

items.Packs/Azure: The day's largest gain at +1,383 against 3 deleted; a same-day commit adds a check that Azure's yml and py files match (#45420).
items.Packs/Orca: +1,160/-242 for the event collector's pagination and cursor handling fix, plus a new _ENTRY_STATUS field (#45415).
items.Packs/GuardiCore: Gains 962 lines against a single deletion, restoring nearly the 963 lines yesterday's revert removed.
items.Packs/TrendMicroDeepSecurity: Gains 621 lines against a single deletion — the largest addition-only pack untouched by yesterday's revert.
items.Packs/HuaweiNetworkDevices: Gains 411 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/CorelightZeek: Gains 374 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/Armis: Gains 321 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/CyberArkEPM: Gains 281 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/Workday: Gains 274 lines against a single deletion.
items.Packs/HealthCheck: +254/-51, one of only four packs with substantial deletions; no commit subject names it.

items.Packs/CommunityCommonScripts: +194/-39; no commit subject names the pack.
